criteria.requirement: BARs 1..64 own independent captures/render states with no cross-BAR leakage.
check: Run XY engine fixtures with distinct BAR-unique stereo PCM and assert each READY slot matches only its BAR source.

criteria.requirement: Existing 64-BAR XY trajectory save/restore remains point/time/coordinate exact; schema and UI selection stay unchanged.
check: Run StateModelTests round-trip and compare all XY points/timestamps for all 64 BARs.
Assert serialization identifiers and selected BAR are unchanged.

criteria.requirement: Host Sync ON/OFF maps phase sample-accurately across fixed/variable blocks and tempo updates without ordinary BAR phase resets.
check: Run XY timeline tests for Host Sync ON/OFF at block sizes 64,128,256,512,1024 and variable blocks.
Assert every sample maps to the independent expected BAR phase and tempo change preserves phase.

criteria.requirement: X rising reads forward and X falling reads reverse; interpolation matches reference and never reads outside capture.
check: Compare ramp and stereo impulse reads to scalar linear interpolation within 2e-6.
Assert read indices remain within [0, barFrames-1] for endpoints and random trajectories.

criteria.requirement: Y produces -12/0/+12 semitones within 1% frequency error with unchanged BAR duration and independently of X direction/slope.
check: Render fixed sine fixtures at Y bottom/middle/top; estimate frequency and duration.
Repeat each pitch with X forward, reverse, and hold; assert pitch error <=1% and equal output length.

criteria.requirement: Stationary X produces a 20ms micro-loop with a continuous 2ms seam, not a held sample.
check: Render stationary X over a nonconstant source; verify repeated 20ms texture and seam discontinuity below the defined click threshold.

criteria.requirement: Direction reversals and implied read rates above 4x use a bounded 3ms crossfade, reach target, remain finite, and stay in range.
check: Render reversal and large-jump fixtures; measure exactly the bounded transition duration (<=3ms), assert post-transition read equals the requested target within one source sample, all samples are finite, and every read is inside capture.

criteria.requirement: Incomplete capture and pending render are XY-only dry; completed audio replays only after READY and within its BAR/generation.
check: Exercise EMPTY/CAPTURING/QUEUED/RENDERING/READY states and assert no XY read before READY.
Assert first-pass output and stale-generation output are dry for XY only.

criteria.requirement: DEPTH 0 is bit-exact dry; XY-only mix and preset-only legacy output, plus LENGTH/SPEED/PITCH scope, follow the plan.
check: Compare bit patterns at DEPTH 0.
Run preset-only golden regression and XY-only depth interpolation; vary preset LENGTH/SPEED/PITCH while asserting XY render remains unchanged.

criteria.requirement: XY-only, preset-only, simultaneous, OFF+XY, no trajectory, missing capture, bypass, and STOP are independent; XY failure never alters preset output.
check: Run every listed layer state and compare preset-only output bitwise to its baseline when XY is absent or unavailable.
Measure simultaneous correlated-signal peak; assert no limiter is applied.

criteria.requirement: Stereo channels use linked trajectory/read positions and preserve inter-channel identity/phase within deterministic tolerance.
check: Run identical and phase-offset L/R fixtures and verify linked read positions plus documented correlation/phase tolerance.

criteria.requirement: Loop/seek/STOP/restart/time-signature/sample-rate changes never read stale or partial PCM; confirmed loops preserve completed captures.
check: Exercise all transport transitions with generation-unique PCM; assert no stale or partial reads.
Assert READY slots survive confirmed loop, seek, stop, and restart; invalidated slots stay XY-dry until recapture.

criteria.requirement: No NaN/Inf, audio-thread allocation, lock, ValueTree, file I/O, or logging; pool allocation is bounded and failures/queue overflow fail XY dry only.
check: Run realtime instrumentation over max block/sample-rate matrix and allocation/lock sentinels.
Inject allocation failure and queue saturation; assert preset output remains unchanged and finite.

criteria.requirement: Deterministic XY, TimelineScratchEngine, RuntimeSmoke, StateModel tests and Windows VST3 CI pass on one source HEAD; diagnostic WAVs cover all motions and pitch extremes.
check: All named deterministic test executables exit 0 on the same commit.
Windows VST3 CI succeeds for that source HEAD and uploads diagnostic WAVs for forward/reverse/hold/jump/pitch extremes.

criteria.requirement: Jev 1.13 individually judges AC-01..AC-16 against the exact plan hash and bounded evidence; FAIL, UNKNOWN, or unavailable blocks promotion.
check: Run the official Plan Compliance Gate and verify exactly 16 AC results are PASS with the pinned Jev 1.13 provider/model.
Verify the gate rejects any UNKNOWN, missing evidence, or plan hash mismatch.

criteria.requirement: Before promotion, verify exact successful CI artifact provenance (source HEAD/run, ZIP, bundle tree, AMD64 PE, internal binary SHA-256), keep candidate untouched, and retain FL listening as NOT TESTED.
check: Verify the successful CI run commit equals the reviewed clean source HEAD; verify the downloaded ZIP, bundle tree, AMD64 PE machine type, and internal binary SHA-256.
Assert the canonical candidate tree/binary hashes are unchanged from the pre-review baseline.
Report FL Studio listening as NOT TESTED until user confirmation.
